subject: science
domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions
skillName: Balanced and Unbalanced Forces on Motion

items.prompt:
A force is
A) a color
B) a push or a pull
C) a sound
D) a weight only
items.answer: B) a push or a pull

steps: A force is a push or a pull.

items.prompt:
Balanced forces are equal and act in
A) the same direction
B) opposite directions
C) no direction
D) circles

steps: Balanced forces are equal and opposite.

items.prompt:
Balanced forces change an object's motion
A) always
B) never
C) only sometimes
D) only at night

steps: Balanced forces do not change motion.

items.prompt:
A still ball is pushed from one side and starts moving. The forces were
A) balanced
B) unbalanced
C) zero
D) equal

steps: The motion changed, so the forces were unbalanced.

items.prompt:
A book rests still on a table. The forces on it are
A) unbalanced
B) balanced
C) only downward
D) only upward

steps: The still book shows balanced forces.

items.prompt:
Which is a way unbalanced forces can change motion?
A) Keep it exactly the same
B) Start it moving
C) Make no difference
D) Change its color

steps: Unbalanced forces can start, stop, speed, slow, or turn an object.

items.prompt:
In tug of war the flag does not move. This shows the pulls are
A) unbalanced
B) balanced
C) only one team pulling
D) zero on both sides

steps: The unmoving flag shows equal and opposite pulls.

items.prompt:
A rolling wagon speeds up when pushed from behind. The forces are
A) balanced
B) unbalanced
C) zero
D) equal and opposite

steps: Speeding up is a change in motion, so the forces are unbalanced.
